item.text: Inspecting the bulletin for the circulation table and the most recent reporting date, then I’ll extract the per-capita dollar figure directly from the text.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'grep -n -i -E "per capita|currency and coin|coin in circulation|circulation" /mnt/data/LSF/data/officeqa/text/treasury_bulletin_2016_03.txt | head -n 80'
